steps.code:
# Check if current song 93 is in liked list - not in first page. Fetch all pages.
liked_ids = set()
page = 0
while True:
    result = apis.spotify.show_liked_songs(access_token=login_result['access_token'], page_index=page, page_limit=20)
    if not result:
        break
    for song in result:
        liked_ids.add(song['song_id'])
    page += 1
print("Total liked songs:", len(liked_ids))
print("Current song 93 liked?", 93 in liked_ids)

# Current song 93 is not liked. Go to previous song and check until we reach a liked song.
max_attempts = 100
for i in range(max_attempts):
    # Go to previous song
    prev = apis.spotify.previous_song(access_token=login_result['access_token'])
    print("Previous song result:", prev)
    # Get current song
    current = apis.spotify.show_current_song(access_token=login_result['access_token'])
    print("Current song:", current)
    if current['song_id'] in liked_ids:
        print("Reached liked song:", current['title'])
        break
else:
    print("Did not find liked song within attempts")
